{{Short description|Literary awards for mystery and crime writers}}
The '''Agatha Awards''', named for [[Agatha Christie]], are literary awards for mystery and crime writers who write in the traditional mystery subgenre: "books typified by the works of Agatha Christie . . . loosely defined as mysteries that contain no explicit sex, excessive gore or gratuitous violence, and are not classified as [[hardboiled|'hard-boiled.']]"<ref>{{cite web |url=http://malicedomestic.org/agathas.html |title=Agatha Awards |website=malicedomestic.org |access-date=11 January 2022 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200506055840/http://malicedomestic.org/agathas.html |archive-date=6 May 2020 |url-status=dead}}</ref> At an annual convention in Washington, D.C.,<ref>[http://www.malicedomestic.org/aboutmalice.html Malice Domestic] {{webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20151005172114/http://www.malicedomestic.org/aboutmalice.html |date=2015-10-05 }}</ref> the Agatha Awards are handed out by '''Malice Domestic Ltd''', in six categories: Best Novel; Best First Mystery; Best Historical Novel; Best Short Story; Best Non-Fiction; Best Children's/Young Adult Mystery.  Additionally, in some years the [[#Malice Domestic Poirot Award|Poirot Award]] is presented to honor individuals other than writers who have made outstanding contributions to the mystery genre, but it is not an annual award.

Early meetings of the Malice Domestic Committee occurred in fall 1987, with the first convention held on April 21–23, 1989, in Silver Spring, MD.<ref>{{cite journal |last1=Morman |first1=Mary |title=In the Beginning |journal=Ten Years of Malice (Domestic) |place=Bethesda, MD |publisher=Malice Domestic Ltd.|page=8|date=1998 }}</ref><ref>{{cite journal |title=Malice History at a Glance |date=1998 |journal=Ten Years of Malice (Domestic) |place=Bethesda, MD |publisher=Malice Domestic Ltd.| page=10 }}</ref> Malice Domestic Ltd was incorporated in 1992. It is governed by a volunteer board of directors.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.malicedomestic.org/agathaawards.html |title=Malice Domestic Ltd: Agatha Awards |publisher=Malicedomestic.org |access-date=2012-06-05 |url-status=dead |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170121111008/http://www.malicedomestic.org/agathaawards.html |archive-date=2017-01-21 }}</ref>
